text:
anna: Heads-up — PR #4823 (CLI migration guide) is queued for review. CI preview is green but it's currently blocked waiting on reviewers / merge owner. Need an owner to merge before EOD PT if possible. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood/4823

mike: I can take a look in ~30m. Any target merge time? Are we under a merge-freeze window today?

jess: I skimmed the API snippets earlier — just a couple tiny nits. Can't approve until the docs linter error on the tutorial heading is fixed.

anna: Good catch. I pushed a fix in branch `docs/cli-migrate` to remove the stray H1. CI rerun kicked off: https://ci.redwood/1234/docs-preview/4823

docs-bot: Build finished — docs preview ✅. Artifacts: https://docs-preview.redwood/4823

liam: Quick note: our docs reviewer rotation still has coverage gaps for Fridays. We're getting slower on turnarounds. Suggestion: add a dedicated weekly rota or add CODEOWNERS for /guides/* to improve coverage.

sarah: Agreed — product needs faster merges for migration guides. Can we assign two reviewers on this PR ( @jess + @liam ) and a merge owner? Also propose a weekly reviewer owner schedule: Mon-Anna, Tue-Jess, Wed-Liam, Thu-Mike, Fri-floating.

jess: I can approve once I push the snippet fix. Doing that now.

liam: I'll act as merge owner for this one — will merge after +1 and green CI. Planning to merge at 16:45 PT if nothing blocks.

anna: Please add a note in the PR description about migration/backport guidance for Dedicated customers and flag the SDK snippet for a quick smoke test.

mike: We'll also need to update our internal doc about reviewer rotas at `/docs/contrib/review-rotation.md`. I'll open a follow-up PR after this merges.

jess: Pushed the tiny snippet change and fixed the example import. LGTM.

docs-bot: PR #4823: Status changed to "approved" by jess. CI: all checks passing.

liam: Merging now. :shipit:

anna: Thanks all — merged. Follow-ups: mike to open rota PR, I'll add CODEOWNERS entry for /guides, and we should surface reviewer coverage gaps in the weekly docs sync. Closing this thread.
